en.topic_title: Hong Kong police arrest 61-year-old man over suspected drink spiking of Japanese DJ Mao Hamasaki
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong police have arrested a 61-year-old man for allegedly spiking drinks and drugging a Japanese DJ at a Halloween party.



Japanese DJ Mao Hamasaki says she was drugged during a Halloween party at a Hong Kong nightclub on November 1, 2026. Photo via Facebook.



Police said on Tuesday that the suspect was arrested the previous day in Central on suspicion of “administering poison with intent to injure.” He has been detained for investigation.
